findings.evidence: Lines 256-266 use `Ring`/`CommRing` solely to invoke `Subring.sum_mem`/`Subring.prod_mem`. Mathlib's corresponding closure results assume only `AddCommMonoid`+`ContinuousAdd` / `CommMonoid`+`ContinuousMul` (`continuous_finset_sum`, `continuous_finset_prod`); `IsIRCSafe.comp₂` at line 231 already works for arbitrary topological codomains, so nothing in the proof needs a ring.
findings.fix: Add `IsIRCSafe.add` for `[AddCommMonoid X] [ContinuousAdd X]` (`comp₂ continuous_add`) and `isIRCSafe_finset_sum` at `[AddCommMonoid R] [ContinuousAdd R]` via `Finset.sum_induction` or an `AddSubmonoid` of safe observables; likewise `isIRCSafe_finset_prod` at `[CommMonoid R] [ContinuousMul R]`. Keep `ircSafeSubring` and derive its `add_mem'`/`mul_mem'` from those.
findings.issue: `isIRCSafe_finset_sum` assumes `[Ring R] [IsTopologicalRing R]`, but only addition is used; the multiplicative structure is unused. This excludes the file's own flagship example class — `V`-valued observables such as `Multiset.sum` (line 288) and the later multiset-of-jet-momenta — from any additive closure result, despite the module docstring (lines 35-37) claiming vector-valued quantities are covered by the same definitions. Same problem at line 263 for `isIRCSafe_finset_prod` (`[CommRing R]` where `[CommMonoid R] [ContinuousMul R]` suffices), and there is no `IsIRCSafe.add`/`IsIRCSafe.mul` at all outside the subring fields.

findings.evidence: The proof body (lines 298-300) uses the hypotheses exactly twice: `IsModuleTopology.toContinuousAdd` and `IsModuleTopology.continuous_bilinear_of_finite_left g`. In Mathlib, `isModuleTopologyOfFiniteDimensional` (`Mathlib/Topology/Algebra/Module/FiniteDimension.lean:270-271`) is `@[local instance]` — "Not declared as a global instance only for performance reasons" — so a finite-dimensional `T2` normed `V` does not satisfy `[IsModuleTopology ℝ V]` by instance search.
findings.fix: State the general lemma with the continuity hypothesis: `theorem isIRCSafe_bilin [TopologicalSpace V] [ContinuousAdd V] (g : LinearMap.BilinForm ℝ V) (hg : Continuous fun q : V × V => g q.1 q.2) : IsIRCSafe (fun s : Multiset V => g s.sum s.sum)`, and keep the current finite-dimensional statement as a corollary applying `IsModuleTopology.continuous_bilinear_of_finite_left`.
findings.issue: `isIRCSafe_invariantMassSq` assumes `[IsModuleTopology ℝ V] [Module.Finite ℝ V]`; both are used only to produce continuity of `fun q => g q.1 q.2` and `ContinuousAdd V`. `IsModuleTopology ℝ V` is not derivable by instance search for the intended target (a finite-dimensional normed/Minkowski `V`, which is the topology §0.3 of the roadmap names), so the lemma as stated is not applicable there without the user re-deriving the instance.

summary: The closure lemmas sit one level too high: sums and products of safe observables are stated only for ring-valued observables, which excludes the vector-valued observables this file itself advertises as the point of the codomain-generic definitions, and the invariant-mass lemma carries finite-dimensionality/module-topology hypotheses where only continuity of the bilinear form is used.
